fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: No function of the game or of the Toolkit DLLs reads or writes the component (only the registration bg3.exe+0xD0EBF0 and ls::GetTypeName exist).

open_questions: Dead type in every build examined: bg3.exe has only the registrations (bg3.exe+0x139DA0, +0xD0EBF0), the Toolkit and macOS have no reader or writer.

macOS default constructor: 'stp x0, xzr, [x23]' and 'stp xzr, xzr, [x23, #0x10]' - a non-zero first qword (likely the null EntityHandle) and zeros after it, which fits the ecl TimelineActorDataCreateDestroyRequest shape (EntityHandle, Guid, flags) better than (Guid, Guid). macOS only, so not used.
status_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
second_pass: Re-checked users and macOS: still nothing reads or writes the component; the macOS default constructor hints at an EntityHandle first, which is not enough to declare members. Left as four opaque qwords, low.
